title: Homelab Overview
description: One screen for the cluster: what is firing, saturation per node, workloads near their limits, storage and the gateway.

panels.title: Critical alerts
panels.description: Alerts that page #critical. The table below lists them.

panels.title: Vault
panels.description: Sealed after every restart of vault-0: unseal with 3 keys.

panels.title: Last WAL archive
panels.description: Age of the last WAL segment archived to Garage by the Postgres master. archive_timeout is 30 min.

panels.title: Pressure stall
panels.description: Share of time at least one task waits for CPU, memory or IO. The earliest sign of saturation, before usage hits 100%.

panels.title: Root disk busy
panels.description: dm-0 is the root LV, which also holds the Longhorn replicas and etcd. The sdX devices are Longhorn volumes attached to the node.

panels.title: Memory vs limit (top 10)
panels.description: Above ~85% the cgroup reclaims the page cache of the container (major faults), then OOMKills it.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!=""}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", job="kube-state-metrics"}))

panels.title: CPU throttled (top 10)
panels.description: Share of CFS periods where the container hit its CPU limit.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!=""}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!=""}[5m])))

panels.title: Garage free space
panels.description: Single node, replication factor 1: holds Terraform state, Postgres backups and GitLab objects.
